relatedNodes.html: Your gut reaction to this may be somewhere along the lines of, “She’s amazing of course, I wouldn’t be marrying her if she wasn't!”
It’s one thing to feel excited about marrying your future wife, it’s another thing to know what she is all about. Compatibility, not attraction, is one of the main things that makes a marriage work.

Vibrant, fun, and energetic are a few of the definitive characteristics of a Colombian woman. These ladies love to sing and dance, and they are passionate lovers. They also value stability in a marriage, particularly in the financial aspect.

By many accounts, Colombian women are fantastic wives. They aren’t shy, either. They will give you a piece of their mind whenever they see fit. They are devoted, loving, and loyal as long as you show them the love, respect, and loyalty they deserve.

They are strong-willed and know how to use their charm to get what they want out of their man. Of course, any man planning to marry one has taken this as part of the package and is all too enthusiastic about it.

Most Colombians, with the majority being Catholics, expect a proper wedding ceremony. This means that preparations have to be done around a year in advance to book not only the church for the marriage ceremony, but also the venue for the reception.

If you choose to reside permanently in Colombia, you can apply for a migrant visa (M-1) and be eligible for residency after two years. You can’t go wrong with choosing to live in Colombia as the country has so much to offer.
Conversely, if you choose to live in the US, for example, your wife can apply for a CR-1 visa.

At the end of the day, there should be few problems marrying a Colombian woman. The real question doesn’t just boil down to where you were born or to what culture she grew up in. The question becomes more about how you plan to handle married life together.

Many couples barely even touch on planning a day beyond the wedding itself, much less a life together. The best gift you and your future wife can give each other is a serious conversation about who you are now and what you want to do and be in the next ten, twenty, fifty years down the line.
